other_conditions: Applicant must not have received any financial assistance or subsidy from government organization for self employment.
Applicant can receive the scheme benefit only once.
Applicant must have a commercial driving license.
If renting a vehicle to someone else, an affidavit must be submitted with the commercial driving license.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹80,000 subsidy (or 10% of on‑road price, whichever is lower) per beneficiary, plus a matching subsidy from the vehicle manufacturer.
